name: Boku no Natsu Asobi
source:
Just before summer vacation main character, who is illustrator's apprentice, gets a request to take care of a children for several weeks. Protagonist can not find a reason to reject the offer. So starts his summer in a villa with three little girls who call him "Onii-chan".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假前夕，插画家的学徒主角接到了照顾孩子几周的请求。主角找不到拒绝的理由。于是，他和三个小女孩在别墅里开始了他的夏天，她们都称他为“Oni-chan”。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
